title: Delete Messages on client and leave it on the IMAP server
creator: michael.martin1966
content:
Hi,

I'm missing the the possibility to delete Messages on one of my clients and leave it on the server. I'm using Thunderbird on my desktop, mostly to save my important emails. Therefore I have installed some filters to delete unimportant mails like newsletter, noreplay@... e.g... Unfortunately I'm not able to read these mails even more on my other client like my mobile. In an older version of Thunderbird was a checkbox for "leave it on the server".. in the latest version this box is gone. Who can help me?

Thanks a lot.

title: Mail delle cartelle archivio 2013/2023 sparite
creator: mikehcl
content: Buongiorno, purtroppo ho un problema serio con thunderbird, mi sono accorto da alcuni giorni che le le mail archiviate dal 2013 sino ad oggi 2023 sono sparite, vedo le cartelle “2013/2023” e la cartella principale “archivio” in corsivo ma non cliccabili, non posso entrarci per aprire le mail archiviate, se metto il mouse sulla cartella 2023 leggo che mi dice che ci sono 43 messaggi e basta, nelle altre leggo 0. Inoltre se provo ad archiviare una qualsiasi e-mail mi esce scritto che l’operazione non può essere eseguita, seguita da una errore. Queste mail sono salvate sul server o sbaglio? Ho pure formattato qualche mese fa e thunderbird mi ha scaricato tutto, mail vecchie e archivi correttamente. Ho provato pure a cancellare l’account e disinstallare thunderbird ma non é cambiato nulla.

title: Slow and freezes after the new update 115.4.1 (win10)
creator: theshopbase
content:
Hello, as soon as TB Thunderbird was auto updated to the new version 115.4.1 (64-bit) 2 weeks ago, it keeps freezing randomly but often for several seconds when you click inbox folders from Any Emails I have: Private, Outlook, Yahoo, or Google.

It does also freeze randomly while I write emails or I check other folders. It take so much longer to deal with emails all together.

It tends to do it if the program has been opened recently but also in the midle of the day or while writing emails, for no reasons.

The previous version was also slower but was at least manageable.

What is going on? Any hints or different solutions are appreciated. Best Regards, Chris

title: Come creare scorciatoia per scaricare solo i messaggi di un determinato account

content: Salve, uso Thunderbird per monitorare le mie caselle di posta e avrei bisogno di creare una scorciatoia per controllare se sono presenti nuovi messaggi SOLO per un account specifico. title: After upgrade from Thunderbird 102.15.1 to Thunderbird 115.4.1the traditional view changed and all of my inbox folder disappeared. I would like to restore the traditional view
creator: janthony2
content: After upgrade from Thunderbird 102.15.1 to Thunderbird 115.4.1 the traditional view changed and all of my inbox folder disappeared. After some view changing some update occurs and as I can understand there is a 'unified view'. I hate such a kind of view, all subfolders are not under the inbox, and I would like to see each of my IMAP mail account with their folders independently as in the traditional view. How to restore the traditional visualization of mail accounts? Please note that I cannot set the menu View folders->All folders (I hoped to restore the traditional visualization in that way...). If I try to set the All folders view, the menu check returns to View->Unified folders any time and I cannot see the traditional view... The only way to return to my tradition IMAP folder visualization is to restore Thunderbird 102.15.1 with a backupped profile. How to restore the traditional view with each IMAP account independent with their inbox, sent, trash and personal subfolders?

title: Recurring (network/shared) calendar events with notification sound keep re-pinging every minute
creator: spiraldancing
content:
This has been a problem for me for years, across multiple machines and OSes (all flavors of Linux), and many versions of Thunderbird. I've looked for solutions online, and I've never even seen anyone else describe the same problem.

I create recurring reminders ("Remember to do 'X' every day at 6:30") with a custom-selected notification sound (a little bell), and when the reminder comes due, the notification sound keeps re-playing every minute ... I mean, literally, exactly, every 60 seconds.

It only seems to happen with shared/subscribed online calendars (I use Nextcloud for my shared calendars).

This is not a snooze setting issue. My snooze is set to the default value of 10 minutes, plus this happens immediately after the reminder first pops up, even without "snoozing" it.

I am currently running Thunderbird 115.3.1 on Linux Mint Debian (LMDE 6), but again, this dates back to Thunderbird 80-something, maybe even earlier, and has persisted on Linux Mint (Standard), Ubuntu, PopOS, probably others I'm forgetting (all Debian flavors).

My best guess is Thunderbird is doing a minute-ly refresh from the Nextcloud CalDAV server, and somehow, it is interpreting each refresh as "play it again, Sam".

Any tips or suggestions are appreciated. Thanks in advance. -s

Edit to add: I just noticed, when I have multiple reminders in the Reminders pop-up, when I update one of them (snooze or dismiss), the other(s) immediately re-play the notification sound -- again, it feels like my local change is triggering an update to/from the CalDAV server, which is then triggering Thunderbird to re-play the notification sound.
